limitations: No source skeleton or exact labeled foot landmarks survive image generation.
A contact-band center displacement is not alone proof of unwanted motion.
Different painted foot widths cannot both be corrected by one rigid translation.
Engine animation timing, transitions, mirroring, stack counts and battlefield grounding remain untested.
method: For each non-death native frame, find the lowest alpha>=64 painted row below y235, and the projection of the last four painted rows. These were visually inspected as boots in the native sheets. The horizontal band center includes intended stride/lean; it is not a measured skeleton-root trajectory. The reference ground line is y266, reference x pivot197. No frames are moved, fitted or warped.

legionRecruit.stationary_fidget_limitation: Contact-band center spans 1.0 native pixels; painted boot-band widths range [44, 44]. One constant family translation cannot remove these changing frame-relative positions, and aligning one toe cannot align both differently painted foot extents. Repair would require a newly constrained painted cohort or separately reviewed rigid pose translations; no per-pose warp is applied.
